name: Hong Ying
bio: Hong Ying is aFamous British-Chinese writer and poet, one of the representatives of China's new female literature. She studied at Lu Xun College of Literature at Beijing Normal University and Fudan University in Shanghai. She began writing poetry in 1981 and began publishing novels in 1988.
